verdict.rationale: The Fin Agent API docs refer to a 'Preview API version', which implies the API is versioned. Nothing in the pack documents a version scheme, a version-pinning mechanism, or a deprecation and sunset policy. Missing for 10: documented versioning scheme and pinning, published deprecation/sunset policy and timelines, changelog of breaking API changes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: are currently available in the Preview API version only
